content: The K. al-Manāhij is a minutely detailed treatise on logic in the manner of the latter-day philosophers, with a general introduction and four methods (manhaj); it follows contemporary method in the main (e.g. the four-term syllogism) but at points prefers the views of the ancients, and it was edited by Ibrāhīm Dībājī (Tehran, 1376 Sh./1997).
